title: Canonicalize Monorepo Target Names
description: Refactor the way scripts are handled across the semio monorepo so every script uses the NAME.script.ts convention and package.json / nx targets execute those scripts consistently with bun and nx. Migrate the complete monorepo to this style, update references, and validate the relevant build/test entrypoints.
summary: Migrated active monorepo script references to the NAME.script.* convention across root/package Nx targets and in-file script invocations. Fixed stale repo client entrypoint paths from repo/mcp to repo/client/mcp, bound GOWORK where root-level Go execution is required, updated repo client help/tests accordingly, and validated the corrected repo client run/build flow plus focused repo client tests.
